The Adventures · 03

Apron and Cupcake Decorating Party

Kids unleash their inner artists in this delightful workshop, creating gourmet treats that look as good as they taste. We include aprons for them to personalise and wear proudly.

We begin by having every child design their own custom apron, helping them dive into a world of artistic expression. From there, we move on to decorating delicious cupcakes with a variety of colorful toppings and glazes, creating a wonderfully tasty finale for the group.

2.5–3H TOTAL TIME, FOR PRICING CONTACT US
